Our Core Diagnostics & Services

Computer Analytics & Diagnostics

We analyze thousands of data packets across your car's wiring and control modules using professional oscilloscopes to pinpoint exact failures.

Safety System Checks

Your brakes and critical safety systems run over High-Speed CAN-Bus networks. We use specialized equipment to identify hidden electrical issues.

Software Updates & VIN Programming

Vehicles need updates just like phones. We offer full VIN programming and software flashes to keep your modules running properly.
